overview_description.description:
Yummy develops a food delivery app that operates across Latin America. The app allows users to order and pay for their orders through their mobile application or website platform and offers different payment methods such as foreign credit cards and cash, that conveniently enable users to enjoy their food at a location of their choice.

Vicente Zavarce founded Yummy in 2020 and has its headquarters in San Francisco, California, United States.
